standard: BANA Nemeth Braille Code for Mathematics and Science Notation 2022
scope: Loaded Electron workflows only. A verified row has both creation and MathJax-navigated editing evidence; unit/SRE/MathCAT fixtures do not substitute for it.

families.creationTest: new equations use the same empty Nemeth replacement draft and commit once
families.editingTest: MathJax-focused Nemeth editing replaces only the selected subtree with an atomic code

families.creationTest: renderer applies immediate, structural-followup, and atomic Nemeth codes in one real draft
families.editingTest: nested numerator replacement preserves the containing fraction

families.creationTest: renderer creates a nested script and radical through compositional Nemeth cells
families.editingTest: MathJax navigation edits a nested Nemeth subexpression without widening the target

families.creationTest: renderer applies immediate, structural-followup, and atomic Nemeth codes in one real draft
families.editingTest: MathJax-focused Nemeth editing replaces only the selected subtree with an atomic code

families.creationTest: six-key input feeds the same Nemeth draft transition as Unicode cells
families.editingTest: six-key input feeds the same Nemeth draft transition as Unicode cells

families.creationTest: Nemeth modifier creation and MathJax base navigation edit preserve the overbar scope
families.editingTest: Nemeth modifier creation and MathJax base navigation edit preserve the overbar scope

families.creationTest: Nemeth function creation and MathJax argument navigation edit preserve application structure
families.editingTest: Nemeth function creation and MathJax argument navigation edit preserve application structure

families.creationTest: Nemeth geometry atom creation and MathJax whole-scope editing preserve the local code
families.editingTest: Nemeth geometry atom creation and MathJax whole-scope editing preserve the local code
